description: This file contains the minified and unminified source code for the FullCalendar library v2.2.7, including internal utilities, class system, DOM utilities, date and time handling, locale management, as well as core calendar functionalities and UI components such as Popover and DragListener. It is a central source file that defines the behavior and features of the calendar system for the project.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Base class for inheritance used within FullCalendar for creating subclasses and mixins.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: A rectangular, absolutely positioned overlay UI component with show/hide and positioning logic.

classes.name: GridCoordMap
classes.description: Converts pixel coordinates into grid cells, helps in determining cell underneath pointer.

classes.name: ComboCoordMap
classes.description: Combines multiple coordinate maps into one, queries through all to find cell underneath.

classes.name: DragListener
classes.description: Tracks mouse movements over coordinate maps, handles drag start, move, and scroll logic.

classes.name: MouseFollower
classes.description: Creates a clone element that visually tracks the mouse during drag operations, with options for revert animation and positioning.

classes.name: RowRenderer
classes.description: Utility class for rendering table rows, flexible for different row types like day rows or helper rows.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: An abstract class representing a time grid with cells for a calendar view. Handles rendering, cell coordinate calculations, and event interactions.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Manages rendering and interaction of the top toolbar with buttons and title in the calendar.

classes.name: EventManager
classes.description: Handles fetching, adding, updating, rendering, and removing calendar events. Manages event sources and normalization.

classes.name: BasicView
classes.description: Abstract view class that renders a grid of days or months, managing dimensions, headers, and events.

classes.name: MonthView
classes.description: Extends BasicView to render a month with fixed or variable weeks, ensuring 6-week display if fixed.

classes.name: fcViews.agenda
classes.description: Extends View to implement an agenda view, combining time grid and all-day day grid with scrolling and event interaction.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for the FullCalendar library, merging with existing defaults.

methods.name: mergeOptions
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple option objects into a target object, avoiding array traversal.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Configures locale settings for FullCalendar, merging locale-specific options and setting defaults.

methods.name: moment
methods.description: Extended Moment.js object with additional methods for handling ambiguous timezones, formatting, and parsing.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a Moment object, transferring ambiguity flags.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Gets or sets the time portion of a Moment; special handling for ambiguous times.

methods.name: stripTime
methods.description: Strips time from a Moment, making it ambiguous, useful for date comparisons.

methods.name: hasTime
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if the Moment has a non-ambiguous time.

methods.name: stripZone
methods.description: Removes timezone offset, making the zone ambiguous while preserving date/time.

methods.name: hasZone
methods.description: Whether the Moment has a non-ambiguous timezone zone.

methods.name: local
methods.description: Converts Moment to local time, marking ambiguity flags as appropriate.

methods.name: utc
methods.description: Converts Moment to UTC, clearing ambiguity flags.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the Moment as a string, accounting for ambiguity flags for time and zone.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts Moment to ISO string, respecting ambiguity flags.

methods.name: isWithin
methods.description: Checks if the Moment falls within a start-end range.

methods.name: isSame
methods.description: Checks if two moments are the same, with handling of ambiguity flags.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Checks if the Moment is before another, considering ambiguity.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Checks if the Moment is after another, considering ambiguity.

methods.name: computeCoords
methods.description: Recomputes the drag-critical positions of elements, updating the coordinate map and scroll bounds.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events to determine if a drag should start or continue, based on move distance.

methods.name: startDrag
methods.description: Explicitly initiates a drag operation, setting internal flags, trigger callbacks, and detecting the cell under the mouse.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Handles ongoing dragging, updates the cell under the cursor, and manages scrolling during drag.

methods.name: cellOver
methods.description: Called when mouse moves over a cell; triggers 'cellOver' event callback.

methods.name: cellOut
methods.description: Called when mouse leaves a cell; triggers 'cellOut' event callback.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Handles mouse up event to stop dragging and listening to mouse events.

methods.name: stopDrag
methods.description: Ends a drag operation, triggers 'dragStop' callback.

methods.name: stopListening
methods.description: Removes mouse event handlers for dragging.

methods.name: getCell
methods.description: Returns the grid cell underneath the mouse event coordinates.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Utility to trigger a named callback if it exists in options.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents default browser action for an event, used to disable selections.

methods.name: computeScrollBounds
methods.description: Calculates the bounding rectangle of the scroll element, used for auto-scrolling.

methods.name: dragScroll
methods.description: Determines scroll velocity based on cursor proximity to container edges during drag.

methods.name: setScrollVel
methods.description: Sets the scroll velocity, initiating continuous scrolling if needed.

methods.name: constrainScrollVel
methods.description: Ensures scroll velocities do not exceed container bounds, setting to zero if limits are reached.

methods.name: scrollIntervalFunc
methods.description: Performs scrolling at each interval based on current velocities.

methods.name: stopScrolling
methods.description: Stops the scrolling interval and re-computes element positions.

methods.name: scrollHandler
methods.description: Handles scroll events, updates cell coordinates if not scrolling via animation.

methods.name: isCellsEqual
methods.description: Utility to compare two cell objects for equality, considering grid, row, and column.

methods.name: MouseFollower
methods.description: Class responsible for creating and managing a clone element that follows the mouse during drag-and-drop.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins tracking mouse movement with a clone element based on sourceEl.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracking and optionally reverts the clone element back to its original position with animation.

methods.name: getEl
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the clone element for dragging, configuring its CSS.

methods.name: destroyEl
methods.description: Removes the clone element from the DOM.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the clone element's CSS to follow the current mouse delta.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Updates mouse delta and moves the clone element accordingly.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Temporarily hides the clone element.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows and positions the clone element.

methods.name: renderEventResize
methods.description: Renders a visual indication of an event being resized.

methods.name: destroyEventResize
methods.description: Unrenders any visual indication of an event being resized.

methods.name: renderHelper
methods.description: Renders a mock 'helper' event during drag operations, optionally matching the source segment's style.

methods.name: destroyHelper
methods.description: Removes the helper element from DOM.

methods.name: renderSelection
methods.description: Renders a visual indication of a user selection, either helper or highlight.

methods.name: destroySelection
methods.description: Removes visual indication of user selection.

methods.name: renderFill
methods.description: Renders background, highlight, or business hours fills over specified segments.

methods.name: renderFgSegs
methods.description: Renders foreground event segments on the grid.

methods.name: destroyFgSegs
methods.description: Removes foreground event segments.

methods.name: renderSegTable
methods.description: Creates HTML table for event segments, positioning each segment properly.

methods.name: updateSegVerticals
methods.description: Repositions event segments after resize or zoom.

methods.name: computeSegVerticals
methods.description: Calculates top and bottom positions for each event segment.

methods.name: fgSegHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single event segment with proper classes and inline styles.

methods.name: generateSegPositionCss
methods.description: Returns CSS for positioning an event segment horizontally and vertically.

methods.name: generateSegVerticalCss
methods.description: Returns CSS for the vertical position (top, bottom) of a segment.

methods.name: groupSegCols
methods.description: Groups segments into columns for rendering, based on their `col` property.

methods.name: placeSlotSegs
methods.description: Orders event segments within a column, computing forward/backward coordinates and levels.

methods.name: buildSlotSegLevels
methods.description: Builds hierarchical levels of segments to detect collisions.

methods.name: computeForwardSlotSegs
methods.description: Calculates the forward collision chains for segments.

methods.name: computeSlotSegPressures
methods.description: Assesses how many segments lie in the longest forward chain, affecting width and position.

methods.name: computeSlotSegCoords
methods.description: Assigns backward and forward relative coordinates to segments based on collision chains.

methods.name: computeSlotSegCollisions
methods.description: Finds segments that vertically collide with a given segment.

methods.name: isSlotSegCollision
methods.description: Determines if two segments occupy overlapping vertical space.

methods.name: compareForwardSlotSegs
methods.description: Comparator function prioritizing segments with higher forward pressure for layout.

methods.name: View
methods.description: An abstract class providing common framework for calendar views, handling rendering, sizing, date computations, and event interactions.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the current date and updates the view range accordingly.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the date range of the view explicitly.

methods.name: computeRange
methods.description: Determines start and end dates based on a reference date, interval duration, and hidden days.

methods.name: computePrevDate
methods.description: Returns the previous date based on current range and interval.

methods.name: computeNextDate
methods.description: Returns the next date based on current range and interval.

methods.name: massageCurrentDate
methods.description: Adjusts a date to avoid hidden days, ensuring full visibility.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the view's title string based on the current range.

methods.name: computeTitle
methods.description: Generates a title string from current date range.

methods.name: computeTitleFormat
methods.description: Decides format string for date range title.

methods.name: formatRange
methods.description: Formats a date range into a string, considering RTL and whether days have explicit times.

methods.name: renderView
methods.description: Renders the view, including size adjustment, scrolling, and event rendering.

methods.name: destroyView
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys current view state.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Recalculates size-dependent layout and elements.

methods.name: updateWidth
methods.description: Changes the horizontal size of the view.

methods.name: updateHeight
methods.description: Changes the vertical size of the view.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the view height explicitly.

methods.name: computeScrollerHeight
methods.description: Calculates height for scroll container.

methods.name: initializeScroll
methods.description: Resets scroll to saved position.

methods.name: recordScroll
methods.description: Records current scroll position.

methods.name: restoreScroll
methods.description: Restores previous scroll position.

methods.name: renderViewEvents
methods.description: Renders all events for the view and triggers post-render events.

methods.name: renderEvents
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement event rendering.

methods.name: destroyViewEvents
methods.description: Destroys event segments and cleans up.

methods.name: destroyEvents
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement event destruction.

methods.name: resolveEventEl
methods.description: Allows custom rendering of event elements with eventRender hook.

methods.name: showEvent
methods.description: Makes event segments visible.

methods.name: hideEvent
methods.description: Hides event segments.

methods.name: eventSegEach
methods.description: Iterates over event segments, optionally filtering to specific event.

methods.name: getEventSegs
methods.description: Returns all event segments for the view.

methods.name: isEventDraggable
methods.description: Determines if an event can be dragged based on options and event properties.

methods.name: reportEventDrop
methods.description: Completes an event drop, updates via calendar, triggers API event.

methods.name: triggerEventDrop
methods.description: Triggers 'eventDrop' event handlers.

methods.name: reportExternalDrop
methods.description: Handles external element drops, creating events if needed.

methods.name: triggerExternalDrop
methods.description: Triggers 'drop' and 'eventReceive' handlers when external element is dropped.

methods.name: renderDrag
methods.description: Visual indication during drag of events or external elements.

methods.name: destroyDrag
methods.description: Removes visual drag indication.

methods.name: isEventResizable
methods.description: Checks if an event can be resized.

methods.name: reportEventResize
methods.description: Handles event resize completion, updates the event, triggers eventResize.

methods.name: triggerEventResize
methods.description: Triggers 'eventResize' event handlers.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Creates a visual selection and reports it.

methods.name: renderSelection
methods.description: Draws visual selection indicator.

methods.name: reportSelection
methods.description: Updates state and dispatches 'select' event.

methods.name: unselect
methods.description: Clears selection.

methods.name: destroySelection
methods.description: Removes visual selection.

methods.name: documentMousedown
methods.description: Handles auto-unselect when clicking outside selection.

methods.name: initHiddenDays
methods.description: Initializes hidden days array.

methods.name: isHiddenDay
methods.description: Checks if a day is hidden.

methods.name: skipHiddenDays
methods.description: Advances date to next visible day.

methods.name: computeDayRange
methods.description: Calculates the visible day range for an event or range.

methods.name: isMultiDayEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event spans multiple days.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main calendar view elements into DOM, including headers and subcomponents.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and removes view elements and subcomponents from DOM.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the display date range for the view and configures subcomponents accordingly.

methods.name: computeRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates for the view based on input date.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Recalculates layout sizes after container resizing.

methods.name: updateWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the view's width and cell sizes.

methods.name: updateHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the view's height to fit a given size.

methods.name: getEventSegs
methods.description: Returns all currently rendered event segments.

methods.name: renderEvents
methods.description: Renders a list of events onto the view.

methods.name: destroyEvents
methods.description: Removes all event elements and segments from the view.

methods.name: renderSelection
methods.description: Displays a visual indication of user selection range.

methods.name: destroySelection
methods.description: Removes any visual selection indication.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Executes a callback registered for a specific event name, if any.
